sizing-and-box-sizing.label: Sizing and Box Sizing
sizing-and-box-sizing.summary: Control how the inherited portfolio's boxes measure width and keep images from overflowing their pages.

sketch1.title: Keep the inherited image inside its container

sketch2.title: Give main content a readable maximum width

try_sizing_and_box_sizing_sketch0.title: Try it yourself: Use border-box site-wide
try_sizing_and_box_sizing_sketch0.prompt:
**Problem**

As borders and padding are added, element dimensions become harder to reason about when those additions expand the declared size.

**Task**

Keep the full cumulative stylesheet and add `*, *::before, *::after { box-sizing: border-box; }`.

try_sizing_and_box_sizing_sketch1.title: Try it yourself: Keep the inherited image inside its container
try_sizing_and_box_sizing_sketch1.prompt:
**Problem**

The inherited profile image can become wider than its available container on a narrow page, forcing unwanted horizontal overflow.

**Task**

Keep all earlier CSS and add `max-width: 100%;` and `height: auto;` to an `img` rule.

try_sizing_and_box_sizing_sketch2.title: Try it yourself: Constrain the main content width
try_sizing_and_box_sizing_sketch2.prompt:
**Problem**

On wide screens, the main content can stretch too far across the viewport, making paragraphs harder to read.

**Task**

Keep every earlier style and add `main { width: 90%; max-width: 64rem; }`.

try-sizing-and-box-sizing-sketch0.title: Use border-box site-wide
try-sizing-and-box-sizing-sketch0.prompt:
**Problem**

As borders and padding are added, element dimensions become harder to reason about when those additions expand the declared size.

**Task**

Keep the full cumulative stylesheet and add `*, *::before, *::after { box-sizing: border-box; }`.
try-sizing-and-box-sizing-sketch0.hint: Apply the sizing model consistently to elements and their pseudo-elements.

help.concept: Border-box sizing makes `width` calculations include `padding` and borders, giving the whole site a more predictable sizing model.
help.hint_1: Apply the sizing model consistently to elements and their pseudo-elements.
help.hint_2: The preview may change only subtly now, but later `width` constraints should behave more predictably across elements.

try-sizing-and-box-sizing-sketch1.title: Keep the inherited image inside its container
try-sizing-and-box-sizing-sketch1.prompt:
**Problem**

The inherited profile image can become wider than its available container on a narrow page, forcing unwanted horizontal overflow.

**Task**

Keep all earlier CSS and add `max-width: 100%;` and `height: auto;` to an `img` rule.
try-sizing-and-box-sizing-sketch1.hint: Constrain `width` and let `height` follow the image's natural ratio.

help.concept: A fluid maximum `width` prevents `overflow` while automatic `height` preserves the image's aspect ratio.
help.hint_1: Constrain `width` and let `height` follow the image's natural ratio.
help.hint_2: Resize the preview: the image should shrink with its container instead of forcing horizontal `overflow` or becoming distorted.

try-sizing-and-box-sizing-sketch2.title: Constrain the main content width
try-sizing-and-box-sizing-sketch2.prompt:
**Problem**

On wide screens, the main content can stretch too far across the viewport, making paragraphs harder to read.

**Task**

Keep every earlier style and add `main { width: 90%; max-width: 64rem; }`.
try-sizing-and-box-sizing-sketch2.hint: Combine a fluid `width` with an upper limit instead of using one fixed `width`.

help.concept: A flexible percentage `width` with a rem-based ceiling lets the layout adapt while keeping a readable upper bound.
help.hint_1: Combine a fluid `width` with an upper limit instead of using one fixed `width`.
help.hint_2: Widen and narrow the preview: main should scale with the viewport until it reaches the maximum `width`.
